kevin_support: FYI escalation from support — HelioMaps (tenant: helio-23) onboarding blocked. Bulk embedding jobs return 403; SSO stuck at ACS. Customer has decision window in 48h. Ticket #83499. Need CS to pick up comms and a short mitigation plan. :rotating_light:
alertbot: Ticket #83499 created by kevin_support. Priority: high.
kevin_support: repro: POST /v1/embeddings -> {"error":403, "reason":"quota_enforced"}. last_success: 1766604000. debug token tx_HM23 attached to ticket.
lina_cs: on it. Quick questions: did they attempt a full historical ingest? any large bulk jobs?
kevin_support: they kicked off a bulk delta import (~8k vectors) at 1766603955. Logs show a routing decision that returned quota errors.
omar_ops: seeing a routing flag flip during release window that briefly routed helio-23 to shared quota pool (1766603940-1766604010). I can enable a tenant-level fallback: route to m-lite and enable prefix caching. CLI: redwood-cli tenant set helio-23 --route m-lite --prefix-cache on. Will hold until comms are sent.
lina_cs: draft ack to customer: "Thanks HelioMaps — we're triaging this now. We're scheduling a 30min enablement call today at 15:30 PST to walk through next steps. As a temporary measure we'll enable a fallback routing to resume ingest without re-upload; ETA to restore: ~90m. We'll follow up with a full RCA and permanent fix plan." Approve?
kevin_support: customer confirmed 15:30 PST. Please apply fallback after ack sent.
omar_ops: applying fallback now.
alertbot: Ticket #83499 updated: fallback applied by omar_ops at 1766604205.
omar_ops: metrics show ingestion rates recovered and 403 errors dropped to near 0 since 1766604220. :rocket:
lina_cs: I'll run the enablement session and capture notes. Quick handoff: issue = onboarding routing->shared-quota; mitigation = m-lite + prefix cache; owners = omar_ops (ops), kevin_support (support), lina_cs (CS). Renewal risk: medium until stable for 48h, escalate to renewals if regression.
rachel_renewals: flagged. I'll monitor and set a check-in at 48h.
kevin_support: attaching SAML trace and debug logs to ticket. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
